topic: No bus, so a taxi on LINE

guest.name: 小池さん
guest.name_jp: {小池和子|こいけかずこ}さん
guest.role: {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}'s only taxi driver, {恵子|けいこ}さん's old classmate; cheerful and fast-talking

title_jp: バスが{運休|うんきゅう}、タクシーを{呼ぶ|よぶ}
context: Tuesday 22 December, the winter solstice ({冬至|とうじ}): after 4th-period English at {鷹ノ原高校|たかのはらこうこう}, the 4 o'clock bus is cancelled because of snow. アルちゃん books the town's only taxi on LINE, and {小池|こいけ}さん, the driver, reminds him about ゆず{湯|ゆ}.
scene: Tuesday, the winter solstice. Snow has cancelled the 4 o'clock bus home from school. You message {小池|こいけ}さん, the town's only taxi driver.

phrases.jp: バスだけでなく、{電車|でんしゃ}も{止まって|とまって}います。
phrases.en: Not only the buses but the trains are stopped too.
phrases.note: だけでなく… も: not just X, Y as well.

phrases.jp: {現在|げんざい|currently, at present|3}、{電車|でんしゃ}は{運転|うんてん}を{見合わせて|みあわせて|to suspend, hold off|2}います。
phrases.note: The classic station announcement on snowy days.

phrases.jp: {渋滞|じゅうたい|traffic jam|3}で{遅れて|おくれて}、すみません。
phrases.en: Sorry I'm late, there was a traffic jam.

phrases.jp: {正門|せいもん|main gate|2}の{手前|てまえ|just before, this side of|3}で{止めて|とめて}ください。
phrases.en: Please stop just before the main gate.
phrases.note: Useful in any taxi: 〜の{手前|てまえ}で = just before ~.

phrases.jp: {駅|えき}まで、{料金|りょうきん|fare, charge|3}はいくらぐらいですか。
phrases.en: About how much is the fare to the station?

dialogue_setting: LINE, Tuesday afternoon. You're in the school entrance; {恵子|けいこ}さん gave you {小池|こいけ}さん's LINE for days like this.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {小池|こいけ}さん、{急に|きゅうに|suddenly|4}すみません。{高校|こうこう}まで{迎え|むかえ|picking someone up|3}に{来て|きて}もらえますか。
dialogue.en: {小池|こいけ}さん, sorry this is so sudden. Could you come and pick me up at the high school?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {雪|ゆき}の{影響|えいきょう|effect, influence|3}で、4{時|じ}のバスが{運休|うんきゅう|service cancelled|2}になっちゃって…
dialogue.en: Because of the snow, the 4 o'clock bus has been cancelled…

dialogue.speaker: 小池さん
dialogue.jp: はいはい、アルちゃんね！{今日|きょう}は{雪|ゆき}だけでなく{風|かぜ}も{強くて|つよくて}ね
dialogue.en: Yes yes, アルちゃん! Today it's not just snow, the wind's strong too.

dialogue.speaker: 小池さん
dialogue.jp: {国道|こくどう|national highway|2}が{渋滞|じゅうたい|traffic jam|3}してるの。{今|いま}{駅前|えきまえ}だから、20{分|ぷん}はかかるわ
dialogue.en: The main road is jammed. I'm at the station now, so it'll take at least 20 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。{寒い|さむい}ので、{校舎|こうしゃ|school building|2}の{中|なか}で{待って|まって}います。
dialogue.en: That's fine. It's cold, so I'll wait inside the school building.

dialogue.speaker: 小池さん
dialogue.jp: もうすぐ{着く|つく}よ！{正門|せいもん|main gate|2}の{手前|てまえ|just before, this side of|3}に{止めて|とめて}おくからね〜
dialogue.en: Almost there! I'll stop just before the main gate~

dialogue.speaker: 小池さん
dialogue.jp: そうそう、{今日|きょう}は{冬至|とうじ|winter solstice|2}。{かぼちゃ||pumpkin|3}だけでなく、{ゆず湯|ゆずゆ|bath with yuzu citrus|2}もね♨
dialogue.en: Oh yes, today's the winter solstice. Not just pumpkin, a yuzu bath too ♨

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {ゆず湯|ゆずゆ|bath with yuzu citrus|2}？どうして{冬至|とうじ|winter solstice|2}に{入る|はいる}んですか。
dialogue.en: A yuzu bath? Why do you take one on the solstice?

dialogue.speaker: 小池さん
dialogue.jp: {風邪|かぜ|a cold|4}をひかないようにって、{昔|むかし}から{言う|いう}のよ。{恵子|けいこ}ちゃん、もう{用意|ようい|preparation|3}してるはず
dialogue.en: So you don't catch a cold, people have always said. {恵子|けいこ}ちゃん will have it ready already.
dialogue.note: {恵子|けいこ}ちゃん: they were classmates, so ちゃん even at 60-plus.

listening.intro: As you get into the taxi, {小池|こいけ}さん says one more thing.

lines.jp: {今日|きょう}はゆず{湯|ゆ}で、しっかり{温まって|あたたまって|to warm up|3}ね。
lines.en: Have a good warm-up in a yuzu bath today.

grammar.form: noun: + だけでなく ({雪|ゆき}だけでなく, バスだけでなく) · verb / い-adj: plain + だけでなく ({食|た}べるだけでなく, {安|やす}いだけでなく) · な-adj: + なだけでなく ({便利|べんり}なだけでなく)
grammar.explanation: Adds a second thing on top of the first: 'not just X, Y too'. The second part usually has も. In casual talk you'll hear だけじゃなくて; だけでなく sounds a bit more careful or written. Don't confuse it with だけ alone, which limits ('only').

examples.jp: {小池|こいけ}さんは{運転|うんてん}だけでなく、{話|はなし}も{上手|じょうず}だ。
examples.en: {小池|こいけ}さん is good not only at driving but at talking too.

examples.jp: このアプリは{便利|べんり}なだけでなく、{無料|むりょう}です。
examples.en: This app isn't just handy, it's free too.

quiz.question: {冬至|とうじ|winter solstice|2}には、かぼちゃを{食べる|たべる}＿＿、ゆず{湯|ゆ}にも{入る|はいる}。
quiz.en: On the solstice you don't only eat pumpkin, you also take a yuzu bath.
quiz.explain: Verb (plain) + だけでなく, then も/にも for the extra thing.

quiz_more.question: この{町|まち}は{静か|しずか}＿＿、{人|ひと}も{優しい|やさしい}。
quiz_more.en: This town isn't only quiet, the people are kind too.
quiz_more.explain: な-adjectives keep な: {静|しず}かなだけでなく.

quiz_more.question: 「バス、{止まってる|とまってる}？」「バス＿＿、{電車|でんしゃ}も{止まってる|とまってる}よ」
quiz_more.en: 'Is the bus stopped?' 'Not just the bus, the trains too.'
quiz_more.explain: だけじゃなくて is the casual way to say だけでなく.

kanji.where: Written in small red letters on 22 December on the staff-room calendar, and on the supermarket's pumpkin sign.
kanji.breakdown: {冬至|とうじ}: 冬 winter + 至 reach, arrive → the day winter reaches its peak: the shortest day.

tip.title: The solstice at home
tip.body: On {冬至|とうじ} many families eat pumpkin and take a ゆず{湯|ゆ}, a bath with whole yuzu floating in it, to stay healthy through winter. Many {銭湯|せんとう} float yuzu that day too, so it's a good day to go.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん on the family LINE: 「バス{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}？{迎え|むかえ|picking someone up|3}に{行こう|いこう}か？」 Tell her the bus was cancelled because of the snow, but {小池|こいけ}さん is coming to pick you up, so it's fine.
challenge.model_answer: {雪|ゆき}でバスが{運休|うんきゅう|service cancelled|2}になったけど、{小池|こいけ}さんが{迎え|むかえ|picking someone up|3}に{来て|きて}くれるので{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です！
challenge.explanation: {雪|ゆき}で gives the cause, and 〜けど sets up the 'but'. {迎|むか}えに{来|き}てくれる = she's kindly coming to get you, and ので gives the reason it's fine. With {恵子|けいこ}さん, です keeps it warm but polite.
challenge.hint: cause with で, then 〜てくれるので

vocab.note: 〜の{影響|えいきょう}で = because of ~ (news and announcements love it).
{運|うん} from {運転|うんてん} run + {休|きゅう} rest. Buses and trains on snow days.
{迎|むか}えに{来|く}る / {行|い}く = come / go to pick someone up.
{渋滞|じゅうたい}する = be jammed. On traffic news: {渋滞|じゅうたい}{情報|じょうほう}.
{学校|がっこう} school + {舎|しゃ} building. {新校舎|しんこうしゃ} = new building.
Directions and taxis: {信号|しんごう}の{手前|てまえ} = just before the lights.
Formal {今|いま}: announcements, news, signs. {現在地|げんざいち} = you are here.
For services: taxis, buses, phones. Goods have {値段|ねだん}.
{風邪|かぜ}をひく = catch a cold. Sounds like {風|かぜ} wind.

kanji_study.parts: 卬 a person looking up at someone + 辶 road radical → going out along the road to meet someone arriving: welcome.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 近 (near): both have 辶, but 迎 has 卬 inside and 近 has 斤.

kanji_study.kun: あらわ(れる)・あらわ(す)
kanji_study.parts: 王 (originally 玉 jewel) + 見 see → a jewel catching the light and coming into view: appear, what is here now.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 規 (rule): 規 has 夫 on the left, 現 has 王.
